title: Impulse Buying
description: Buying something suddenly without thinking about whether you really need it.
tip: Wait 24 hours before buying. If you still want it tomorrow and it fits your budget, then decide.

title: Ignoring Small Expenses
description: Small daily expenses can add up and affect your monthly budget.
tip: Record every small purchase in the Expense Planner for one week — the total will surprise you.

title: Late Payments
description: Forgetting payments can make it harder to manage your monthly expenses.
tip: Set a phone reminder a few days before every due date, and pay fixed bills first each month.

title: Unused Subscriptions
description: Paying for subscriptions that you rarely or never use.
tip: List all your subscriptions, cancel the ones you have not used this month, and review them quarterly.

title: No Spending Plan
description: Spending money without making a simple plan can make budgeting difficult.
tip: Use the 50-30-20 rule to make a simple monthly plan: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings.
